remarks: LAKE LIFE WITHOUT THE LAKEFRONT PRICE TAG! Welcome to The Townhomes at Grandview Bay, ideally located near Lake Erie and the Grandview Bay beach community. This move-in-ready 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhome offers the best of both worlds—a modern, low-maintenance home with the relaxed feel of life at the lake. Inside you'll find a spacious two-story layout, granite countertops, stainless-steel kitchen appliances, a convenient mudroom and attached garage. Outside, leave the yard work behind and enjoy your time where you came to be—the beach, the lake and the surrounding community. Deeded water rights provide lake access, while HOA-maintained grounds help make ownership easy. Ideal as a year-round residence or your own Lake Erie getaway. Come see what life at Grandview Bay could look like!
